[[Platense F.C.|Platense]] | continentalcup2 = | continentalcup2 qualifiers = | league topscorer = [[Denilson Costa|Costa]] (13) | total goals = 314 | matches = 149 | biggest home win = {{tooltip|MOT 7–2 IND|6 April 1997}} | biggest away win = {{tooltip|MAR 0–3 RES|11 January 1997}} | highest scoring = {{tooltip|MOT 7–2 IND|6 April 1997}} | longest unbeaten = | longest losses = | prevseason = [[1995–96 Honduran Liga Nacional|1995–96]] | nextseason = [[1997–98 Honduran Liga Nacional|1997–98]] | updated = 29 June 1997 }} The '''1996–97 Honduran Liga Nacional''' season was the 31st edition of the [[Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras|Honduran Liga Nacional]]. The format of the tournament remained the same as the [[1995–96 Honduran Liga Nacional|previous season]]. [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]] won the title[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesh/hond97.html RSSSF.com – Honduras 1996/97] – 11 December 2009 after defeating [[Platense F.C.|C.D. Platense]] in the finals. Both teams qualified to the [[1998 CONCACAF Champions' Cup]]. Marathón]] and [[Club Deportivo Olimpia]], then Marathón's president [[José Yacamán]] ordered his team to quit the game as he claimed that they were being targeted by referee [[Arturo Tábora]] with controversial calls. The game was not resumed and the result stood 1–2 to Olimpia.[http://www.radiohouse.hn/casos-insolitos-del-futbol-hondureno/ RadioHouse.hn – CASOS INSÓLITOS DEL FÚTBOL HONDUREÑO] – 13 October 2016 * In the last round, [[F.C. Motagua|C.D. Motagua]] defeated [[Independiente Villela]] at [[Tegucigalpa]] with a 7–2 score. This game sentenced Independiente to certain relegation. However, the ''Chorizeros'' protested that Motagua had included defender [[Júnior Izaguirre]] in its lineup. Izaguirre, who was on the bench that day, saw a red card in a reserves game a week prior. In order to avoid further conflicts, the league decided to abolish relegation and invited Independiente to play in the [[1997–98 Honduran Liga Nacional|1997–98 season]]. ==References== {{reflist}} {{Honduran Liga Nacional}} {{1996–97 in Honduran football}} {{DEFAULTSORT:1996-97 Honduran Liga Nacional}} [[Category:Liga Nacional de Fútbol Profesional de Honduras seasons]] [[Category:1996–97 in Honduran football]] [[Category:1996–97 in domestic association football leagues|Honduras]]
